title: Symbolic Powers and Asymptotic Invariants of GL-Invariant Ideals
summary: This work concerns ideals invariant under the action of the group of linear base changes on a generic matrix; we call these GL-invariant ideals. We determine the ordinary powers, their saturations with respect to determinantal ideals, and the symbolic powers of GL-invariant ideals. We give explicit formulas for asymptotic invariants known as (skew) Waldschmidt constants and asymptotic resurgence, which measure the growth of these families and compare the ordinary and symbolic topologies. We also prove that the generalized symbolic Rees algebras associated with these ideals are Noetherian.
